problem_text:
A logistics firm must allocate a fleet of delivery vehicles from distribution hubs C to retail outlets D in order to minimize total fuel expenditure.

The number of vehicles available at each distribution hub (set C) is as follows:
*C1 has 97 vehicles.
*C2 has 63 vehicles.
*C3 has 114 vehicles.
*C4 has 172 vehicles.
*C5 has 79 vehicles.
*C6 has 66 vehicles.

The required number of vehicle deliveries to be received at each retail outlet (set D) is specified below:
*D1 requires 19 vehicles.
*D2 requires 156 vehicles.
*D3 requires 14 vehicles.
*D4 requires 36 vehicles.
*D5 requires 138 vehicles.
*D6 requires 74 vehicles.

The fuel cost per vehicle dispatched from each hub to each outlet is provided in the following table:
| From / To | D1 | D2 | D3 | D4 | D5 | D6 |
|--|-|-|-|-|-|
| C1 | 8 | 4 | 18 | 14 | 20 | 20 |
| C2 | 20 | 8 | 17 | 13 | 15 | 15 |
| C3 | 10 | 19 | 14 | 10 | 19 | 20 |
| C4 | 2 | 20 | 4 | 7 | 7 | 9 |
| C5 | 3 | 6 | 8 | 6 | 18 | 3 |
| C6 | 6 | 1 | 14 | 15 | 20 | 16 |

Determine the optimal vehicle dispatch plan to minimize the aggregate fuel cost.
